mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SURVEY ( SRVY_QITEM, SRVY_RSPNS, CO_SN ) VALUES ( #{srvyQitem}, #{srvyRspns}, #{coSn} )
mapper.select: SELECT SRVY_SN as srvySn, SRVY_QITEM as srvyQitem, SRVY_RSPNS as srvyRspns, CO_SN as coSn FROM TB_SURVEY WHERE SRVY_SN = #{id}

/** *진령 제작 - 회사별 설문 목록 조회 API /
SELECT SRVY_SN as srvySn, SRVY_QITEM as srvyQitem, SRVY_RSPNS as srvyRspns, CO_SN as coSn FROM TB_SURVEY WHERE CO_SN = #{coSn} ORDER BY SRVY_SN DESC
